systems.system: interoperability between civil registry and health services
systems.owner: Ministry of the Interior, Community Development and Public Security and Ministry of Public Health and AIDS Control, supported by UNICEF
systems.tiers: 52 health facilities across Kirundo province since mid-October 2023, hosting civil registry offices where a local registrar registers births and issues birth certificates the same day; about 600 registrations a month in the health centres, per a registrar

note: The article describes registrars' desks in health facilities, which the typology treats as registry offices, but nowhere says the record is digital: the registrar is shown completing the birth register and a parent signing in it. With no digital record stated there is no value to record, so no fact; the class follows the country's own label and the parent may prefer to treat these as offices.
